title: One-plug umbilical
lede: Blue Fiberon PET-GF15 plug and socket in a black enclosure receiver. Exploratory geometry; the insulation and jacket capture are unfinished.

panels.name: Machine side
panels.caption: Flush in back-top: a 47.0 x 44.6 face on a 2.5 mm side ledge, held from inside by two snap leaves.

panels.name: Plug
panels.caption: Ø32.44 across, 52 long. One key clamps all four tubes; the foam on the soda tube stops at the plug.

panels.name: Plugged in
panels.caption: The plug runs 8.2 mm into the 34 mm cup before a stub reaches its hole. The bars meet face to face.

panels.name: Release
panels.caption: FLAVOR-B over DRAIN. Each union floats 1.83 mm: a pull drags it forward until its collet lands on the floor's back face and lets go. Side shows the cut.

panels.name: Through the counter
panels.caption: The plug in the 1⅜″ countertop hole: 1.2 mm a side, 0.9 at its flats' corners.

panels.name: Machine-side plate
panels.caption: The slicer's plate: socket on its flats, retainer, wall coupon roof-down. One pause for the socket's bars.

panels.name: Plug-side plate
panels.caption: The plug upside down on its top flat and the key on end. One pause for the plug's bars.
